We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for a template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the reaction described (Still-Gennari HWE). We have previous step: make_5_lvl2-apply_template-4 gave precursors list: two SMILES strings: "CCO[C]([CH2][C@@H]1[O][C@H](/[CH]=[C](/[CH3])[C](OC)=[O])[C@H]([CH3])[C@@H]([OH])[CH2]1)=[O]" and "O=S(=O)(C(F)(F)F)O[Si](C)(C)C". That seems to be the result of applying a template to the target molecule (the target molecule is not directly given but likely the product). The template applied gave those two precursors. So we need to find the template that gave those precursors. We need to search template catalog with criteria matching the reaction: bonds formed: C=C double bond, C-O (carboxylic ester) formed; bonds broken: C-P, C-C, C-O; triple bond changed to single bond (alkyne to alkene?). Also functional groups formed: C-C double bonds, carboxylic esters. Functional groups broken: maybe phosphonate? The target molecule is likely a product of Still-Gennari: an alkene with Z geometry attached to an ester.

We have the precursors: first SMILES looks like a protected sugar? Actually "CCO[C]([CH2][C@@H]1[O][C@H](/[CH]=[C](/[CH3])[C](OC)=[O])[C@H]([CH3])[C@@H]([OH])[CH2]1)=[O]" This seems like a phosphonate? Not sure. Second SMILES: "O=S(=O)(C(F)(F)F)O[Si](C)(C)C" is a silyl trifluoromethanesulfonate (TMSOTf). That is a reagent used to activate phosphonate? In Still-Gennari, you use a phosphonate ester (e.g., bis(trifluoroethyl) phosphonate) and a base (KHMDS) and then add aldehyde. But here we have a silyl triflate maybe for protection removal.

But we need to find template ID. We can search template catalog by criteria: functional groups formed: "C-C double bond", "carboxylic ester". functional groups broken: maybe "phosphonate ester"? Not sure if available list. Let's get available functional groups.
